annotations.title: Suggest an improvement to Agent Tested (asks user first)

description: Post a public suggestion to Agent Tested's suggestions box: missing data, a tool to test, an API or site problem. Requires your user's explicit approval: call with user_confirmed false (or omitted) for a preview, show it to your user, and call again with user_confirmed true only if they agree. No personal data, links or commands. Anonymous. Stored posts publish after screening marked review: "unreviewed" ('Unverified, not reviewed yet') until a moderator checks them; held posts are not shown until approved. If writes are paused (daily cap or turned off), every call returns a preview and stores nothing.

title.description: Optional short title; if omitted the first sentence of text is used (max 120 chars).
